key_insight: BrainNext is a self-supervised 3D foundation model that learns transferable brain MRI representations from large unlabeled datasets and adapts well to multiple downstream tasks.
clinical_relevance: A general-purpose model like BrainNext could help support more scalable and consistent analysis across diverse brain MRI workflows, including classification, segmentation, and brain-age estimation.
method: Masked autoencoder (MAE) pretraining on 60,551 unlabeled brain MRI exams
Native 3D Bi-Directional xLSTM-UNet architecture for volumetric learning
Lightweight task-specific fine-tuning for downstream applications
evidence_signal: In FOMO 2025 Method Track evaluation, BrainNext placed second overall and first for meningioma segmentation on the official leaderboard.
watch_item: Results are promising but were shown in a benchmark setting, so real-world performance, domain shift, and integration into clinical workflows still need validation.
paper_title: BrainNext: A General-Purpose Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Brain MRI Analysis
